The execution order is calibration at 12, 16 and 20 bits, followed by holdout at 12, 16 and 20 bits. Every strategy, seed domain, candidate score, threshold and null rule is frozen before both phases. Calibration tests integrity and selects no policy. No learned-policy placeholder is used. A later tuning proposal needs an additive amendment, renewed review and an actual published policy binding before a new holdout. Missing curves, target strata or nontrivial matched-null slots are retained as unavailable; they are never replaced to fill a table.

For the interval arm, X_i=sum_j 2^j d_(i,j) is injective because 2^s<p. Membership includes the actual curve-lift condition through an explicit multilinear selector h, alongside every d^2-d equation. Random-base labels use a separately charged lookup polynomial and the same bit domain. This is an explicit prime-field encoding. It uses neither F_2 arithmetic nor an omitted interval-membership predicate.

The original ideal I contains every bit equation, every actual base-membership equation and the raw substituted Semaev equation. S3 is frozen coefficient by coefficient. S4 is the formal degree-two/degree-two Sylvester determinant in a fresh variable before simultaneous specialization; no factor, leading-coefficient-zero branch or intermediate infinity is removed. The known shared S4 defect is addressed by an independent construction and exhaustive source calibration. The author-uploaded Semaev full text, section 2 Theorem 1 and its exceptional-branch proof, was actually read. The canonical IACR PDF was inaccessible in this tool and is not claimed as the read copy.

The Boolean idempotents give a textual finite-algebra lemma: R/Q is the product of F_p over all bit assignments, and adding the membership/Semaev equations removes precisely the nonsatisfying factors. Thus I is radical, all algebraic digit roots are rational, and quotient dimension counts digit roots with multiplicity one. It does not count signed point decompositions. Every bit variable is covered, every label map is injective on admitted labels, and full sign/group reconstruction remains mandatory.

The adaptive policy maintains an exact witness-carrying relation space modulo Q. It builds a divisor-closed monomial set from a scored independent frontier, with attempt-k capacity min(2^n,(n+1)*2^(k-1)), attempts the entire original-ring border, and closes unresolved products/commutator defects under a deterministic support budget. It records every score, rank query, rejected/deferred row and failed candidate. Deferred products survive RREF changes. The first complete certificate returns; there is no postselection by favorable nnz or cost. After sixteen candidate attempts, or exhausted closure without a valid certificate, the algorithm invokes a fresh copy of the matched F4 fallback and pays for the entire failed search plus that fallback. The source four-candidate prediction is therefore tested instead of being made true by censoring later work.

Mourrain–Trebuchet Theorem 3.9 was directly retrieved in full by the checked advisory TASK-20260908-620061 and read in its needed form by this designer. For complete border relations on a set connected to one, the commutation criterion supplies the projection whose kernel is the border ideal J. It does not establish I=J. The contract additionally requires exact polynomial source witnesses for J subset I, original-generator annihilation/reductions for I subset J, complete border columns, and cyclic basis identities. These checks provide basis independence/spanning and dimension |B|. Empty matrices are not an UNSAT certificate: the zero algebra needs an explicit identity 1 in I.

A useful direct justification is N(f)=f(M)e_1. Connectivity and the correct multiplication columns imply N(b)=e_b; commutation makes the kernel an ideal. Repeated border identities show f-N(f) lies in J, so the kernel equals J. The two checked containments then identify J with I. This is a symbolic design derivation subject to independent review, not an independently validated or machine-checked result. The finite formalization interface is specified, while a Lean task is deferred until serialized polynomial/witness semantics and a pinned toolchain/library bridge exist.

Root recovery splits the certified quotient into the 0/1 eigenspaces of successive idempotent multiplication maps. It retains every nonzero branch and verifies one-dimensional final leaves. No field extension is required by this family. Each decoded tuple is expanded through all rational y signs and independently checked against the exact signed target; repeated coordinates, inverse pairs, intermediate O and tuple order survive. Finite recovery fibre counts, L=log2(number of preimages), branching and witness storage are recorded without a group-translation quotient or information-gain claim.

The mandatory controls include the exact forced grevlex normal-set identity, the fully priced identical-generator F4 method, direct signed root and resultant loops, three random staircase schedules, same-support/same-zero-set-conditioned nulls, an unconditioned support-random coefficient null, and matched random bases. The null is not assumed semiregular merely because coefficients are random. Its construction, rejected draws and exact zero-set check are charged, and synthetic algebraic roots are distinguished from valid curve relations.

Known-false fixtures exercise idempotent but noncommuting maps, a dropped root despite generator annihilation, an empty quotient without a unit witness, and equal dimensions with different coordinate actions. In this split radical Boolean family, equal-dimensional quotients are abstractly isomorphic F_p-algebras. Accordingly, the within-family collision uses different ideals/coordinate-labelled actions. The source's genuinely nonisomorphic table collision is also retained, explicitly outside the main family: F_7[x]/(x^2) versus F_7[x]/(x^2-x). This preserves the intended control without asserting a false Boolean-family nonisomorphism.
